ddl.where: "closed_at" is null and "detached_at" is not null
ddl.name: voice_sessions_detached

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'dm') = ("name" is null)
        and ("kind" = 'dm') = ("dm_a_member_id" is not null and "dm_b_member_id" is not null)
        and ("dm_a_member_id" is null or "dm_a_member_id" < "dm_b_member_id")
ddl.name: chat_channel_shape_of_kind

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'human') = ("user_id" is not null)
        and ("agent_id" is null or "kind" = 'agent')
        and ("plan_id" is null or "kind" = 'planner')
ddl.name: chat_member_id_of_kind
